newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB eyes further German investment.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB eyes further German investment.

text.p: Satellite broadcaster BSkyB said on Friday that it may make further investments in Germany following its agreement to take a stake in DF1, Kirch Gruppe's German digital television platform.
"The company is also considering investments in additional German Pay TV channels," BSkyB said in a statement.
BSkyB announced in July that it would take a stake of up to 49 percent in DF1, Germany's first digital venture.

"The extent of the company's obligations and the timing of payments have yet to be determined. It is the intention of the company to equity account for its interests when agreement has been reached, and significant influence obtained," it added in reference to its agreement with Kirch.
